name: Buddha Teas Organic Pure Marshmallow Root Tea
whyItWorks: 100% pure organic Althaea officinalis root. Exceptionally gentle, anti-inflammatory, and creates a slippery protective barrier that calms irritated bowel linings, relaxes smooth muscle spasm, and eases tenesmus.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Steep in hot water for 10 minutes. Can also be cold-brewed in the fridge overnight for maximum extraction of heat-sensitive mucilage.
